newsitem.title: SWEDEN: INSTANT VIEW-Swedish repo cut good for short end.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Swedish repo cut good for short end.

text.p: Following is the reaction of James McKay, analyst at PaineWebber International, to Tuesday's announcement of a 25-basis point rate cut in Sweden's repo rate.
"Given most in the market had expected rates to have bottomed, this is clearly very good news for the short end of the curve.
"The Riksbank obviously feels -- rightly in our view -- that inflation poses little risk either now or in 1997.
"Rate cuts can be expected to continue, with the repo rate falling to 4.0 percent in Q1. Next focus will be the Riksbank's inflation report on due December 17."
